skills.label: Draw in the interface with a mod
skills.desc: Draw panes, a band above the prompt, buttons, and text fields from a Claude Code mod, handle presses and input, and keep state between redraws and sessions.

skills.label: Interface gallery for mods
skills.desc: See the interface elements a Claude Code mod can draw, such as text, buttons, fields, Markdown, code, and diffs, with sample code and terminal screenshots.

skills.label: React to events with a mod
skills.desc: Handle Claude Code events from a mod: observe, rewrite, or answer tool calls, prompts, and turns, filter which events a hook handles, and plan for other mods.

skills.label: Use the mods API
skills.desc: Call the mods API from a Claude Code mod to add commands and tools, call a model, run work on a timer, message other sessions, and reach files and the network.

skills.label: Add components to a plugin
skills.desc: Add skills, hooks, MCP servers, and other component types to a Claude Code plugin, with an example that validates for each.

skills.label: Create a Claude Code plugin
skills.desc: Build your first Claude Code plugin from an empty directory, test it without a marketplace, and convert an existing .claude/ setup.

skills.label: Measure plugin cost and usage
skills.desc: Measure a Claude Code plugin's token cost, find out whether people still use it, and pick the telemetry events for organization-wide plugin questions.

skills.label: Plugin dependencies
skills.desc: Declare the plugins your plugin depends on, with version ranges such as ^1.2, and see how Claude Code installs, resolves, and prunes them.

skills.label: Publish and distribute a plugin
skills.desc: Publish a Claude Code plugin through your own marketplace or Anthropic's directory, with a pre-release checklist and how users get updates.

skills.label: Recommend your plugin from your CLI
skills.desc: Prompt Claude Code users to install your official-marketplace plugin by emitting a claude-code-hint tag from your CLI or SDK.

skills.label: Test plugins with evals
skills.desc: Write eval cases for your Claude Code plugin, run them with claude plugin eval, grade the results, compare against a no-plugin baseline, and gate CI on the score.

skills.label: Manage Claude Code plugins for your organization
skills.desc: Control which plugins Claude Code installs and allows across your organization through managed settings.

skills.label: Manage mods for your organization
skills.desc: Control Claude Code mods with managed settings: stop user-installed mods, allow only your own, review what a mod can do, and enforce policy with your own mod.

skills.label: Create a mod
skills.desc: Have Claude write a Claude Code mod from a description, or write one yourself that counts tool calls and adds a command. Learn the reload and validate loop.

skills.label: Mods overview
skills.desc: Add panes, commands, and tool call rules to Claude Code with a mod. See what a mod can do, how to make or install one, and where mods run.

skills.label: Mods reference
skills.desc: Complete reference for Claude Code mods: hooks module layout, events, mods API methods, render sites, elements by surface, limits, and settings.

skills.label: Test a mod
skills.desc: Write automated tests for a Claude Code mod that fire events, stub Claude Code's answers, and press buttons, with no session, sign-in, or network.

skills.label: Troubleshoot a mod
skills.desc: Find out why a Claude Code mod does nothing: match the symptom or message to its cause, look up refusal messages, and read the debug log.

skills.label: Marketplace reference
skills.desc: Reference for marketplace.json fields, plugin entries, and the plugin and marketplace source objects, with where each is valid.

skills.label: Plugin commands reference
skills.desc: Reference for the claude plugin shell commands, /plugin and /reload-plugins in a session, and the flags that load a plugin for one session.

skills.label: Plugin manifest reference
skills.desc: Reference for plugin.json: fields with types and defaults, accepted path forms, and the userConfig and environment variable schemas.

skills.label: Create a marketplace
skills.desc: Build a plugin marketplace from a marketplace.json file and test it locally before you host it.

skills.label: Host and maintain a marketplace
skills.desc: Publish a plugin marketplace where users can reach it, grant access to a private one, and release updates and renames without breaking installs.

skills.label: Recommend plugins for your org
skills.desc: Add a relevance block to marketplace plugin entries so Claude Code suggests them when a user's work matches, and allowlist the marketplace in managed settings.

skills.label: Plugin loading reference
skills.desc: Trace where Claude Code loads each plugin from, which settings file decides whether it loads, and why an update changed nothing.

skills.label: Troubleshoot plugins
skills.desc: Fix plugin errors in Claude Code. Find the exact message you saw, grouped by stage from where /plugin runs through install and org policy.

skills.label: Anthropic's marketplaces
skills.desc: Anthropic's official and community plugin marketplaces for Claude Code: their names, repositories, how you add each, and where to browse their plugins.

skills.label: Code intelligence plugins
skills.desc: Install a language server plugin so Claude sees type errors after edits and navigates code by symbol, and answer the LSP plugin recommendation dialog.

skills.label: Install and manage plugins
skills.desc: Install Claude Code plugins from a marketplace on any surface you use, choose an install scope, and update or remove them later.

skills.label: Plugin security and trust
skills.desc: Decide whether to trust a plugin before you install it, from what a plugin can do on your machine to how to review one and remove it.

skills.label: Plugins overview
skills.desc: Understand what a Claude Code plugin is, when you need one instead of a standalone skill or MCP server, and which page to read to install or create one.
